title: Fifa scraps controversial World Cup investment plan
summary: FIFA's governing body has abandoned plans to sell stakes in its major competitions following widespread opposition to President Gianni Infantino's proposal. The decision marks a significant reversal for a controversial investment initiative.
content: Football's world governing body abandons plans to sell off stakes in its major competitions after widespread opposition to president Gianni Infantino's proposal.

zh.title: FIFA放弃有争议的世界杯投资计划
zh.summary: FIFA管理机构已放弃出售其主要赛事股份的计划，此前普遍反对国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺的提议。这一决定标志着这一有争议的投资举措的重大转变。
